purpose: Additive non-Mundarica discovery of a Bangladesh government-hosted Munda-language digital archive. The resource is retained as a scope-uncertain lead and is not canonicalized to Indian Mundari until language identity, collection provenance, speaker consent and cultural-access boundaries are independently resolved.

records.title: Munda | Multiling Cloud digital archive
records.publisher: Multiling Cloud / Government of Bangladesh domain (bangla.gov.bd)
records.notes: The live resource labels the language Munda, lists Bangladesh locations, identifies a Community Contributors / Munda Field Recording section, and reports a Full Archive resource density of 860 with phonetic transcriptions and audio recordings. The page does not, by itself, establish equivalence with the Indian Mundari [unr] corpus or the consent/reuse scope of individual recordings.
records.rights_note: The public page displays an all-rights-reserved notice. Public playback/index visibility is not treated as permission to redistribute recordings or transcriptions. Speaker consent, privacy/publicity, contributor authority, community validation and culturally appropriate secondary use remain unresolved.
records.scope_note: Potentially relevant Bangladesh Munda-language archive. Do not merge with Mundari [unr], Munda [unx], or any MLHKP language identity solely from the page label; taxonomy and collection documentation require independent reconciliation.

canonicalization.decision: Retain as one new discovery lead only. Government-domain and multiling.cloud access points are treated as manifestations/access routes of the same archive page, not two sources.
